document.note: Statement by the Secretary-General on the Humanitarian Situation in Gaza, 27 October 2023, as published on the UN's Question of Palestine site (UNISPAL).

quote: About 500 trucks per day were crossing into Gaza before the hostilities began.
caveat: A pre-war average of all trucks, including commercial goods; not a statement of what is needed. Replaces a news report (NPR) that quoted a UNRWA spokesperson describing 500 trucks a day as the humanitarian benchmark.
